test_cases.description: getStepContent returns well-formed StepContent for every valid StepId
test_cases.input_description: Each value of the StepId enum
test_cases.expected_output_description: StepContent with matching stepId, non-empty overview, and valid label

test_cases.description: getStepContent returns objects with all required StepContent fields
test_cases.expected_output_description: Object with stepId, label, overview, commands, callouts, examples fields

test_cases.description: getStepContent throws for an invalid stepId value
STEP_CONTENT has an entry for every StepId enum value
assertions: every StepId key exists in STEP_CONTENT

test_cases.description: Every STEP_CONTENT entry's stepId matches its record key
STEP_CONTENT is frozen and cannot be mutated at runtime
assertions: Object.isFrozen(STEP_CONTENT) is true or mutation throws

test_cases.description: StepPage renders an h1 with content.label text
test_cases.input_description: StepContent with label, overview, commands, callouts, examples, youtubeUrl, version
test_cases.expected_output_description: h1 element containing the label text
assertions: h1 element contains the label text

test_cases.description: StepPage renders the overview text in a paragraph
test_cases.expected_output_description: Paragraph element containing overview text
assertions: overview text is visible in the rendered output

test_cases.description: StepPage renders one CodeBlock per command entry
test_cases.expected_output_description: 2 CodeBlock components rendered

test_cases.description: StepPage renders one CalloutBox per callout entry with correct variant
test_cases.input_description: StepContent with callouts of different variants
test_cases.expected_output_description: CalloutBox rendered for each callout with matching variant

test_cases.description: StepPage renders one CodeBlock per example entry
test_cases.expected_output_description: 2 CodeBlock components for examples

test_cases.description: StepPage renders YouTubeEmbed when youtubeUrl is a non-empty string
test_cases.expected_output_description: YouTubeEmbed component is rendered
assertions: YouTubeEmbed is present in rendered output

test_cases.description: StepPage does not render YouTubeEmbed when youtubeUrl is undefined/empty
test_cases.expected_output_description: No YouTubeEmbed in rendered output

test_cases.description: StepPage renders VersionBadge when version is a non-empty string
test_cases.expected_output_description: VersionBadge component is rendered
assertions: VersionBadge is present in rendered output

test_cases.description: StepPage does not render VersionBadge when version is undefined/empty
test_cases.expected_output_description: No VersionBadge in rendered output

test_cases.description: StepPage renders no command/callout/example sections when arrays are empty
test_cases.input_description: StepContent with empty commands, callouts, and examples arrays
test_cases.expected_output_description: No CodeBlock or CalloutBox components rendered, no section headings for those sections

test_cases.description: StepPage handles undefined/null content prop as missing_content error
test_cases.input_description: content prop is undefined or null
assertions: throws or renders error for missing content
